items.question: What type of businesses is it for?

seo.title: Bukky privacy policy
seo.description: Learn how Bukky collects, uses, and protects data submitted through contact forms, demo requests, and business communications.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: This page explains how we handle information you send when requesting a demo, contacting Bukky, or browsing this website.

sections.title: Controller and contact
body: Bukky is a Wegox product for businesses that manage appointments, clients, and daily operations.
For privacy questions, access requests, correction, or deletion requests, you can contact us at support@wegox.io.

sections.title: Data we may collect
body: When you complete a form, we may collect your name, email, phone number, business name, business type, team size, and the message you share with us.
We may also process basic technical information needed for the website to work correctly, such as device, browser, language, request date, and security logs.

sections.title: How we use the information
body: We use your data to answer your request, coordinate a demo, understand your business context, and prepare a relevant proposal to start with Bukky.
We may also use aggregated or non-identifiable information to improve website content, form experience, and communication quality.

sections.title: Legal basis and communications
body: We process the information you send because you made a direct request and because we need to respond to it in a reasonable way.
If we continue commercial conversations, they will stay within the context of your request and you may ask us to stop contacting you at any time.

sections.title: Providers and email delivery
body: The contact form may use technical providers such as Resend to deliver confirmation emails to the requester and internal notifications to our team.
These providers act as technical infrastructure to process the request and should not use your data for their own unrelated purposes.

sections.title: Data retention
body: We retain information for as long as needed to answer your request, provide reasonable commercial follow-up, and meet applicable technical, administrative, or legal obligations.
If you ask us to delete your data, we will review the request and address it unless certain information must be retained for legitimate or legal reasons.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can request access, correction, deletion, restriction, or objection to the processing of your data by writing to support@wegox.io.
We may ask for additional information to verify your identity before responding to requests related to personal data.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy as the product evolves, processes change, or new providers are added.
The update date shown on this page indicates the current version of this policy.

contactCta.description: We centralize requests through the contact page so we can answer with context and traceability.

seo.title: Bukky terms of use
seo.description: Review the general terms for using the Bukky website, demo requests, intellectual property, availability, and contact.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: These terms cover the public Bukky website, demo requests, and commercial information available before contracting or activating the product.

sections.title: Website use
body: You may browse the Bukky website to learn about the product, review features, pricing, contact information, and request a demo.
You must not use the website to submit false information, interfere with its operation, attempt unauthorized access, or perform activities contrary to the law.

sections.title: Demo requests
body: When you submit a demo request, you authorize us to contact you using the details provided so we can understand your case and coordinate next steps.
Submitting a request does not create a purchase obligation and does not guarantee immediate availability of every feature mentioned on the website.

sections.title: Product information
body: Bukky is presented as a SaaS platform for online booking, appointment management, clients, services, professionals, reminders, and daily operations.
Some features may evolve, enter beta, change in scope, or appear as upcoming improvements depending on product development.

sections.title: Pricing and plans
body: Pricing information published on the website describes the current available plan and may be updated as new capabilities are released.
Any specific commercial condition must be confirmed during the demo, onboarding, or contracting process.

sections.title: Intellectual property
body: The Bukky logo, name, design, copy, interfaces, and visual elements belong to their owners or licensors.
You may not copy, distribute, reuse, or exploit these elements without prior authorization, except where permitted by law.

sections.title: Availability and external links
body: We work to keep the website available and updated, but we do not guarantee that it will always be free from interruptions, technical errors, or content changes.
The website may link to external channels such as WhatsApp, Instagram, or email services. Use of those channels is subject to their own terms.

sections.title: Responsibility
body: The information on this website is informational and commercial. It does not replace specific contractual agreements or final legal documentation for a contracted service.
To the extent permitted by law, we are not responsible for damages arising from misuse of the website or decisions made without validating specific conditions.

sections.title: Changes and contact
body: We may update these terms when the website, product, commercial processes, or applicable requirements change.
For any question about these terms, you can contact us at support@wegox.io or through the contact page.
